name: native

scripts.sync: mkdir -p www && cp ../app/index.html ../app/mmagnifier-logo.svg www/ && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 PATH="/opt/homebrew/lib/ruby/gems/4.0.0/bin:$PATH" npx cap sync

comment_versions: Versions are pinned exactly (no ^) because patch-package patches in patches/ target exact versions. A floating range can silently install a version the patch cannot apply to, which breaks the release build with a confusing ProGuard error.
